author: blu
body: Proves attack (OnAttack) triggers. A creature whose Oracle text says "Whenever ~ attacks, <effect>" compiles to a TriggeredAbility on OnAttack; the combat engine fires it as the creature is declared as an attacker. Serra Zealot pumps itself (+1/+0) when it attacks; Raider drains the defending player for 1 life when it attacks. Both abilities come from parse-creature-abilities, so real attack cards are modelled.
